svg.title: Menu or stuck video: how a freeze alert is decided, in one image
svg.text: AI IN THE LAB · FREEZE ALERTS
A tiny word model decides in 0.25 ms. Only a sure menu is discarded.
No language model, no GPU, 0 USD per call.
The picture stopped moving: is it a problem?
Same alert, two cases. Only one must be kept.
OCR reads the first and the last frame
The same facts a paid AI model used to get, 1.7 s a call.
Each piece has a learnt weight
A typo like Settinqs still shares most pieces with Settings.
Real screens, the words OCR read, the real model's score
Real captures of public pages and apps, first and last frame the same.
A live weather cast or a sports ticker
AI model or vision check answers, as before. Nothing is lost.
Retrained in 1 second from new labels
A new version goes live only if it is not worse. The old file is kept.
On 1,554 subtitle lines it never saw, 0% were called menu.
